engaged, and honestly so, because this change ADDS catch blocks rather than merely carrying them. Three are new. parsePublishedManifest catches JSON.parse and returns null (recovery.mjs:242-244, twin mitosis.js:581-583). resolveRunIdentity wraps its log call in an empty catch (recovery.mjs:276-281, twin mitosis.js:615-620) - copied verbatim from the foldObservedStatus emit helper at mitosis.js:710-715, which is the shape the engine already uses for guarded logging. The publish stage catches any throw from the agent dispatch and continues (mitosis.js:4285-4287), matching checkpoint-init at :4246-4248. Each converts a thrown error to a return value or a log line, so a tagged SandboxViolationError raised inside the agent hook would not survive the publish boundary as a tag; its message does reach the log line, so it is reported rather than discarded. The empty catch around log() is the one that discards outright - it is the same error class as decision 0171's D5 finding, adopted deliberately because a throwing log function must never be able to fail a run identity resolution

The OTHER closed census in this repo, MIRROR_CENSUS, is deliberately NOT extended: both new code homes are existing WHOLE-census modules, so no new lib module exists to classify and mirror-guard's readdir-based halt is not engaged
